messages:
jia: quick sync — I ran a batch of stability tests on 4-bit paths and saw some interesting patterning: models with grouped-attention layout show higher sensitivity to outlier tokens in prompt prefix.
sam: is that the same class of failure where last-token quality drops? how big is the effect?
jia: deg_score increased ~0.04 on long prompts with nested data (json blobs) — seems like some heads underflow the activation distribution.
marta: any simple mitigation short-term?
ben: we tried per-channel bias correction but it was too expensive. another approach is a small fallback policy: detect high-variance input batch and force int8 for that request. cheap but conservative.
sam: can we do fast detection on the client side? e.g., pre-validate for nested blobs and set a hint in precision_hint.
jia: heuristic might help but we can't trust all clients. server-side detector should be cheap — maybe compute skew/kurtosis stats on token embeddings from first 8 tokens.
telemetry-bot: add metric: prefix_input_skewness.
ben: runtime note: avoid allocating per-request big buffers. compute streaming stats with O(1) memory. just collect online moments.
marta: longer-term: plan for a micro-profile taxonomy — small metadata per-profile describing sensitivity (e.g., "nested-json-risk: high"). routing can then prefer robust profiles for tenants that send such traffic.
sam: love the taxonomy idea. keep it simple: a small set of risk tags and recommended trust_level.
jia: sample micro-profile json: 
```
{
  "profile_id": "4b-robust-v1",
  "trust_level": "canary",
  "risk_tags": ["nested-json", "long-context"],
  "expected_memory_overhead": "+12%"
}
```
ben: also propose a compatibility score field that is computed from offline evals (0..1). helps ops route safely.
telemetry-bot: note: store compatibility_score in profile metadata. sample field recorded.
marta: rollout: 1) implement server-side cheap detector for prefix skew and surface as metric 2) tag profiles with risk_tags and compatibility_score 3) conservative routing: if detector fires, route to robust profile or force int8 fallback 4) monitor deg_score and hallucination-rate
sam: add docs for SDK team so precision_hint can be set by clients; but default remains server-side predictive.
ben: action items: @jia build detector POC + attach failure examples, @ben add compatibility_score to profile schema, @sam coordinate SDK doc stub, @marta draft RFC update.
telemetry-bot: job queued: evals/compat-score/1761239876 -> pending
marta: ok that's all for now. short follow up RFC and we'll schedule a cross-functional sync next week. :white_check_mark:
